# HonanSafe — HongAn Fire Equipment Co., Ltd.

> HongAn Fire Equipment Co., Ltd. is a direct factory manufacturer and exporter of fire protection equipment.
> We serve engineering contractors and distributors in Southeast Asia, the Middle East and South America with
> OEM/ODM customisation and complete project package supply.

## Company

- Legal name: HongAn Fire Equipment Co., Ltd. (鸿安消防设备有限公司)
- Brand / domain: HonanSafe — https://honansafe.com/
- Sales email: zwanl@hongan119.com
- Backup email: haffthuang@hongan119.com
- WhatsApp: +86 152 5942 8489
- Key markets: Southeast Asia, Middle East, South America

## Product lines

- [Fire Extinguishers & Cabinets](https://honansafe.com/products/fire-extinguishers.html) — ABC dry powder (1–12 kg), water-based, CO2, wall cabinets
- [Hose, Nozzles & Couplings](https://honansafe.com/products/hose-nozzles.html) — fire hose DN25–DN80, nozzles, couplings, branch fittings
- [Hydrant Systems](https://honansafe.com/products/hydrant-systems.html) — indoor/outdoor hydrants DN50–DN150, boxes, valves, pump connections
- [Sprinkler & Water Systems](https://honansafe.com/products/sprinkler-systems.html) — sprinkler heads, wet alarm valves, flow indicators
- [Fire Alarm Systems](https://honansafe.com/products/fire-alarm.html) — smoke/heat detectors, call points, sounders, panels
- [Gas Suppression & PPE](https://honansafe.com/products/other.html) — clean-agent suppression, fire blankets, firefighter PPE

## Capabilities

- Direct factory manufacturing and quality control
- OEM private label / ODM customisation (branding, packaging, local-standard specs)
- Engineering package supply — multiple product lines consolidated per project
- Certification and export documentation support
- Export shipping to Southeast Asia, Middle East and South America
